description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to grain references in Orleans, including serialization, copying, and invocation mechanisms for grain references within the Orleans runtime. It includes classes like GrainReference, GrainReferenceShared, and various request and serializer classes for handling method calls on grains.

classes.name: GrainReferenceShared
classes.description: Holds properties common to GrainReference instances with the same GrainType and GrainInterfaceType, such as runtime, interface type, version, and serialization providers.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCodec
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of GrainReference objects to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for GrainReference objects.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCopierProvider
classes.description: Provides specialized copier instances for grain reference types.

classes.name: TypedGrainReferenceCopier<TInterface>
classes.description: A strongly-typed copier for grain reference instances of interface type T.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCodecProvider
classes.description: Provides specialized codec instances for grain reference types.

classes.name: TypedGrainReferenceCodec<T>
classes.description: A strongly-typed codec for grain reference instances of interface type T.

classes.name: GrainReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to a grain, supporting method invocation, equality, and string formatting.

classes.name: IRequest
classes.description: Interface representing a request to invoke a method on a grain.

classes.name: RequestBase
classes.description: Base class for method invocation requests, supporting argument handling and invocation.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Base class for method requests returning ValueTask<Response>.

classes.name: Request<TResult>
classes.description: Base class for method requests returning ValueTask<TResult>.

classes.name: TaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Base class for method requests returning Task<TResult>.

classes.name: TaskRequest
classes.description: Base class for method requests returning Task.

classes.name: VoidRequest
classes.description: Base class for void-returning method requests, inherently one-way.

methods.name: FromGrainId
methods.description: Creates a GrainReference from a GrainId.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts the GrainReference to a specified grain interface type.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on GrainId.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns a uniform hash code for the grain reference.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the grain reference.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Invokes a method asynchronously on the grain.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method synchronously on the grain.
